detailed_results.question: What are the different ids and names of the battles that lost any 'Brig' type shipes?

detailed_results.question: What are the ids and names of the battles that led to more than 10 people killed in total.
detailed_results.gold_sql: SELECT T1.id ,  T1.name FROM battle AS T1 JOIN ship AS T2 ON T1.id  =  T2.lost_in_battle JOIN death AS T3 ON T2.id  =  T3.caused_by_ship_id GROUP BY T1.id HAVING sum(T3.killed)  >  10
detailed_results.pred_sql:
SELECT 
    b.id, 
    b.name
FROM 
    battle b
JOIN 
    death d ON b.id = d.caused_by_ship_id
GROUP BY 
    b.id, 
    b.name
HAVING 
    SUM(d.killed) > 10;

detailed_results.question: What is the ship id and name that caused most total injuries?
detailed_results.gold_sql: SELECT T2.id ,  T2.name FROM death AS T1 JOIN ship AS t2 ON T1.caused_by_ship_id  =  T2.id GROUP BY T2.id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1
detailed_results.pred_sql:
SELECT 
    s.id, 
    s.name, 
    SUM(d.injured) as total_injuries
FROM 
    death d
JOIN 
    ship s ON d.caused_by_ship_id = s.id
GROUP BY 
    s.id, 
    s.name
ORDER BY 
    total_injuries DESC
LIMIT 1;
